gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all priority schemes available in Jira so that I can understand how priorities are organized across projects.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of all priority schemes with their respective IDs and names.

gold.user: As a Jira administrator, I want to create a new priority scheme to better manage the priorities for my team's projects.
gold.ideal: The API should accept a JSON payload with the new priority scheme details and return the created scheme's ID and name.

gold.user: As a developer, I want to get suggested priorities for a set of mappings so that I can efficiently assign priorities to issues.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of suggested priorities based on the provided mappings.

gold.user: As a product owner, I want to see the available priorities for a specific priority scheme to ensure they align with our project needs.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of available priorities for the specified priority scheme.

gold.user: As a Jira administrator, I want to delete an obsolete priority scheme to keep our system organized and up to date.
gold.ideal: The API should confirm the deletion of the specified priority scheme and return a success message.

gold.user: As a project manager, I want to update an existing priority scheme to reflect changes in our project priorities.
gold.ideal: The API should accept updated details for the priority scheme and return the updated scheme's information.

gold.user: As a team lead, I want to retrieve the priorities associated with a specific priority scheme to ensure my team is aligned on task priorities.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of priorities linked to the specified priority scheme.

gold.user: As a project coordinator, I want to see which projects are using a specific priority scheme to manage resources effectively.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of projects associated with the specified priority scheme.
